items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: Yeah, Butler Rap is his name. His name, they called him Guy A.

ctx.x: Who was that that just got killed? A musician?
Yeah, Butler Rap is his name. His name, they called him Guy A. Oh sure, yes. Yeah, Walter Beck who killed it.
